subject: session date
fact: The events occur on Planting 16, 579.
source_quote: Date: Planting 16, 579

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr waits for Calmer and the man-at-arms promised by Ranos Davl.
source_quote: The following day, the Zephyr sits for breakfast and waits for the arrival of Calmer and the man-at-arms that Ranos Davl has promised him.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer arrives with polished armor and a cudgel dangling from his wrist as his holy symbol.
source_quote: Calmer arrives first, his armor polished and his holy symbol, the cudgel dangling from his wrist.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is 5’2” tall with copper-red hair, hazel eyes, and a flattish nose.
source_quote: He is short, 5’2”, has copper-red hair, hazel eyes, and a flattish nose.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer has the over-eager look of a religious zealot.
source_quote: He also has that over-eager look that religious zealots have.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer orders boiled eggs, milk, and bread for breakfast.
source_quote: Calmer orders some boiled eggs, milk and bread.

subject: Thorne
fact: Thorne introduces himself as a man-at-arms hired by Ranos Davl.
source_quote: There’s the Tiefling. My boss Ranos said you hired me?

subject: Thorne
fact: Thorne is called Duke by his friends because his name sounds like a throne.
source_quote: My name is Thorne. My friends call me Duke because my name sounds like a throne.

subject: Thorne
fact: Thorne is a rugged man in his late 30s with a weathered face and scars from past skirmishes.
source_quote: He is a rugged man in his late 30s with a weathered face marked by a few scars from past skirmishes.

subject: Thorne
fact: Thorne has cropped short brown hair and piercing green eyes hidden beneath a weather-beaten leather cap.
source_quote: His brown hair is cropped short, and his piercing green eyes are hidden beneath the brim of a weather-beaten leather cap.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia watches Zephyr and his companions to see if anything is off.
source_quote: The masked one had been watching Zephyr and their two new companions, trying to see if anything was off.

subject: Moathouse
fact: The Moathouse is located east of the main road, reachable via a track overgrown with thorns, thistles, weeds, and shrubs.
source_quote: he sees the track heading to the ruins. A scrub of thorns, thistles, weeds, and shrubs grows thickly along the edge of the track leading to the ruins.

subject: Moathouse
fact: The track to the Moathouse is washed out in places and cluttered with fallen branches and trees.
source_quote: Even the track is mostly overgrown and cluttered with fallen branches and trees. Here and there, it is washed out, in other places a mire.

subject: Moathouse
fact: The Moathouse is surrounded by a boggy land with tall marsh plants, cattails, and tamaracks.
source_quote: After two miles, as the track turns more northerly, the land begins to sink and become boggy. Tall marsh plants grow thickly where cattails and tamaracks do not.

subject: Moathouse
fact: The Moathouse has a jagged silhouette visible off to the left of the path.
source_quote: Off to the left can be seen the jagged silhouette of the moathouse.

subject: Moathouse
fact: The Moathouse has a side path banked high to cross the wetland, leading to its entrance.
source_quote: A side path, banked high to cross over the wetland to either side, just north to the entrance of the ruin.

subject: Moathouse
fact: The track near the Moathouse entrance is 15 feet wide with crumbling embankments that make travel dangerous.
source_quote: The track here is only about 15 feet wide or so, with crumbling embankments making travel near the edge dangerous.

subject: Moathouse
fact: The vegetation around the Moathouse is dense, sickly, and unhealthy, with creepers and vines strangling dead and living plants.
source_quote: The vegetation appears dense and prolific, but somehow sickly and unhealthy, creepers and vines throwing their strangling loops over the skeletons of dead saplings and living bushes alike.

subject: Moathouse
fact: The Moathouse has a drawbridge leading into it.
source_quote: The Duke sets up camp just past the drawbridge that leads into the moathouse

subject: giant frogs attack on drawbridge
fact: Four giant frogs jump out of the pool near the drawbridge and attack the party.
source_quote: Four giant frogs jump out of the pool near the bridge and attack.

subject: drawbridge collapses
fact: The drawbridge shatters under the weight of the frogs and the party, causing Sequoia and Calmer to fall in.
source_quote: The frogs' and the party's weight causes the bridge to shatter. Zinia doesn’t fall in, but Sequoia and Calmer do.

subject: giant frog
fact: One giant frog chomps at Calmer and is knocked to death’s door.
source_quote: A frog chomps at Calmer and is knocked to death’s door.

subject: giant frog
fact: Zinia kills one injured giant frog in the water.
source_quote: Zinia jumps into the water and strikes and kills one of the injured Frogs.

subject: giant frog
fact: Zephyr kills the last giant frog with a strike.
source_quote: It’s last. It is dead at Zephyr's hand.

subject: giant frog
fact: An arrow through the eye kills the final giant frog.
source_quote: the last frog is also dead from an arrow that went through the eye and into the amphibian’s skull.

subject: Calmer leads onto drawbridge
fact: Calmer marches onto the drawbridge, declaring it is time for clerics of St. Cuthbert to lead.
source_quote: Calmer shouts, “I think it’s time that I did what all great clerics of St. Cuthbert do, which is lead.”

subject: Zinia patches Calmer's wound
fact: Zinia pulls Calmer out of the water and patches his wound.
source_quote: Zinia rushes to Calmer, pulls him out of the water, and patches his wound.

subject: Thorne
fact: Thorne says he can cook frog legs that taste like chicken.
source_quote: I can cook something nice with those legs. Tastes like chicken.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia glares at Thorne after he comments on cooking frog legs.
source_quote: Zinia glares.

subject: bandits in moathouse room killed
fact: Zephyr uses an illusion to make bandits inside the room open the door.
source_quote: A sudden bang is heard in the room just outside the door. “Zephyr has used an illusion to get the folks inside to open the door for us,” thinks Sequoia.

subject: Zephyr kills first bandit
fact: Zephyr enters the room and kills one bandit, then exits and signals seven more remain and the leader is dead.
source_quote: He hears a body fall to the ground. As Zephyr exits, he indicates seven more left and that the leader is dead.

subject: Zinia kills second bandit
fact: Zinia enters the room and kills another bandit quietly.
source_quote: The satisfying sound of a body hitting the ground quietly precedes Zinia’s return.

subject: Voss
fact: Voss is a bandit who explains he became a bandit due to gambling debts and drinking.
source_quote: He explains, “The Moathouse was a good hideout because nobody wanted to come here anymore. The Temple was dead, and adventurers picked this place clean, so nobody came here.”

subject: Voss
fact: Voss is the bandit who was given a flat river rock inscribed with an eye and a tear by his boss.
source_quote: It’s what the big boss gave the boss who gave it to us. It meant we belonged.

subject: flat river rock with eye and tear
fact: A flat river rock inscribed with an eye and a tear is found in the bandit room.
source_quote: Out of the corner of Sequoia’s eye, he sees a flat river rock inscribed with an eye and a tear.

subject: bandits flee through arrow slit
fact: Three bandits escape through an enlarged arrow slit to the south.
source_quote: Three of the bandits escape to the south through an arrow slit that has been enlarged to allow easy retreat.

subject: Sequoia kills bandit and blocks exit
fact: Sequoia kills one more bandit and stands in front of the exit to block it.
source_quote: Sequoia kills one more of the bandits and then stands in front of the exit, blocking it.

subject: Zinia knocks bandit unconscious
fact: Zinia knocks the captured bandit unconscious with a flurry of blows.
source_quote: Zinia knocks him out with a flurry of blows.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer enters the room and says, “I think it’s important that we call to calm down,” with glee.
source_quote: Calmer walks in and says, “I think it’s important that we call to calm down.”

subject: Voss is interrogated
fact: Voss is woken up and questioned by Sequoia, Zinia, and Zephyr.
source_quote: Sequoia then wakes up the bandit. The poor man wakes up, clears his eyes, and is shocked by a Tiefling, a cleric of St. Cuthbert, and Sequoia staring at him, their weapons covered in the blood of his gang.

subject: Church of St. Cuthbert
fact: Membership in the cult is punishable by death according to Calmer.
source_quote: Calmer explains that membership in the cult is punishable by death.

subject: Moathouse great hall
fact: The Moathouse has a great hall that was once an audience chamber with tattered banners and destroyed furniture.
source_quote: Past the door is a great hall. This was once a great audience chamber, as shown by the tattered banners and tapestries on the walls, destroyed furniture, and heaps of rotting cloth thrown into corners.

subject: Moathouse great hall
fact: The great hall floor is covered in leaves and dirt, and cobwebs hang from walls and ceiling.
source_quote: Leaves and dirt cover the floor, and cobwebs hang from walls and the ceiling above.

subject: Moathouse great hall
fact: The upper stories of the Moathouse are totally destroyed and impassable to anything larger than a rat.
source_quote: Looking up, he sees that pieces of beams and chunks of stone poke through, indicating that the upper stories of the place are totally destroyed and likely to be impassable to anything larger than a rat.

subject: Moathouse door
fact: The door to the Moathouse is hanging open on one hinge and wedged shut from the inside on the other.
source_quote: The door to the moathouse is hanging open on one great hinge. The other is splintered and holed but still in position, wedged and shored closed from the inside.

subject: Sequoia examines foot traffic
fact: Sequoia examines the ground and whispers that foot traffic goes to the northeast door.
source_quote: Sequoia examines the ground and whispers, “The foot traffic goes to the door.”

subject: Sequoia and Zephyr coordinate entry
fact: Sequoia, Zephyr, and Zinia coordinate hand gestures to sneak into the room one at a time.
source_quote: The two rogues and the monk co-ordinate with hand gestures. They will sneak into the room one at a time, attack, and retreat.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr observes human and pack animal traffic near the Moathouse entrance.
source_quote: Zephyr shouts, “Hm, this is interesting. Some human and pack animal traffic comes this way.”

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer volunteers to guard the rear while Zephyr and Zinia investigate ahead.
source_quote: Calmer says, “Perhaps the rogues would like to investigate and see what’s ahead? Let us get a jump on the enemy. I can stay here and guard the rear.”

subject: Thorne
fact: Thorne shouts that the group will die before making it through the door.
source_quote: “So you guys going to die before you even make it through the door,” shouts Thrune.

subject: Thorne
fact: Thorne asks if they are calling it quits after Calmer is injured.
source_quote: Thrune can’t resist, “So are we calling it quits?”

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer declares they will complete their job despite injuries.
source_quote: Calmer shouts, “No. We have come here to do a job and will do it.”

subject: Sequoia leads into Moathouse
fact: Sequoia decides he can lead the group into the Moathouse after Calmer’s declaration.
source_quote: Sequoia decides that he can lead, but Sequoia will observe.

subject: bandit leader killed
fact: The bandit leader is found dead on the ground, pooling in blood in the middle of the room.
source_quote: Sequoia sees the bandit leader dead on the ground, pooling in blood in the middle of the room.

subject: Voss
fact: Voss cries hysterically when he sees the flat river rock with the eye and tear.
source_quote: Voss then starts to cry hysterically and in panic.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer tries to calm Voss by explaining what the Church of St. Cuthbert does to its enemies.
source_quote: Calmer offers to help, but apparently, Calmer’s idea of calming a man terrified of being killed by an Evil Cult is to explain to him what the Church of St. Cuthbert does to its enemies.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr groans that Voss is too low on the totem pole to know anything useful.
source_quote: Zephyr groans, “He’s too low down the totem pole to know anything useful.”

subject: symbol on river rock
fact: The meaning and origin of the flat river rock inscribed with an eye and a tear remain unknown.
source_quote: What’s this?

subject: Temple's death
fact: The Temple associated with the Moathouse is dead and abandoned.
source_quote: The Temple was dead, and adventurers picked this place clean, so nobody came here.
